note: Scripture: every quotation is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), verbatim from the bundled owb-am text (re-quoted 2026-11-18, per the founder decision that every Amharic work quotes OWB; this replaces the 1962 UBS wording and the translator-rendered verses of the first edition). Whole verses are quoted whole, ranges joined with a space, partial verses as the shortest contiguous OWB span carrying the clause; spans were spliced by script and checked against the OWB text.

self_rendered rows: the renderings Bosworth quotes by name (Young, Leeser, Rotherham, Weymouth, Moffatt) and his own corrected reading of Isaiah 53:4, translated from his English; words the critical text OWB follows lacks (1 Corinthians 6:20 'and in your spirit', Ephesians 5:30 'of his flesh, and of his bones'); the Deuteronomy 28 disease list given as bare nouns; Acts 10:34 'a respecter of persons' built from OWB's words; and earlier rows for phrase echoes, epithets and formulas in Bosworth's own voice ('father of lies', 'It is written', the Great Commission phrase list), which are prose, not quotations.

Where Bosworth argues from a King James word OWB does not use, the translated prose carries one bridging gloss rather than a changed verse: 2 Corinthians 12:7 OWB «በሥጋ እሾህ» against the sermon's recurring «መውጊያ»; KJV 'mercy' = OWB «ጽኑ ፍቅር» (Psalm 86:5, 103:8, 145:8); 'buffet' (OWB «ደጋግሞ እንዲመታኝ»); Jonah 2:8 'lying vanities'; Proverbs 14:30 'sound heart'; Mark 1:41, where OWB follows the reading «በቁጣ ተነሣሥቶ» and a note gives the English Bible's 'moved with compassion', on which Bosworth's point rests.
